articles.title: Nxtdev Free Subdomain for Developer's
articles.description: The Free Subdomain Platform For Developer's
articles.content:
🚀 Hey Developers!

Need a domain for deployment?
This one’s just for you 👇

👉 https://nxtdev.xyz

---

🌐 What is nxtdev.xyz?

The story behind the platform empowering developers with professional subdomains and enterprise-grade DNS.

nxtdev.xyz was born from a simple observation: developers need a quick, secure, and professional way to share their work—without the overhead of buying a new domain every time.

Whether it's a portfolio, a side project, or a staging environment, nxtdev.xyz provides the infrastructure to get it online in seconds ⚡

---

✨ Features

- 🌍 Free Subdomains (up to 2 per user)
- ⚙️ Full DNS Record Control (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, SRV)
- 🔒 Automated SSL & Proxying
- 🛡️ Enterprise-Grade Safety Checks
- 🔁 Nameserver Delegation Support
- ⚡ Blazing Fast Propagation
- 👨‍💻 Built for Developers

---

💡 Start building, sharing, and scaling—without limits.
